message.send.title: Send a message
message.send.whenToUse: To write in a conversation you may write to, as a new message or as a reply to a given message, with text or a media item.
message.send.whenNotToUse: Not for your ordinary reply here: that is your normal answer. Not for a conversation you were not given.

message.edit.title: Edit your message
message.edit.whenToUse: To correct one of your own earlier messages when you notice a mistake in it or are told about one.
message.edit.whenNotToUse: Not for someone else's message, and not to rewrite what you said only because the conversation moved on.

message.delete.title: Delete your message
message.delete.whenToUse: To remove one of your own messages that should not stay.
message.delete.whenNotToUse: Not for someone else's message, and not to hide a message people already answered.

message.react.add.title: Add a reaction
message.react.add.whenToUse: To react to a message with an emoji instead of, or besides, writing.
message.react.add.whenNotToUse: Not in a conversation you were not given.

message.react.remove.title: Remove your reaction
message.react.remove.whenToUse: To take back one of your own reactions.
message.react.remove.whenNotToUse: Not for reactions other people left.

draw.title: Draw a picture
draw.whenToUse: To make one picture and post it in a conversation you may write to. It costs money and has a daily limit.
draw.whenNotToUse: Not when words are enough, and not again for a picture that already failed to post.

memory.read.title: Read your notes on a member
memory.read.whenToUse: To look up what you remember about a member when the conversation needs it.
memory.read.whenNotToUse: Not to show someone notes they may not see.

status.show.title: Check your state
status.show.whenToUse: To see how you are running right now: limits, pause, what is on and off.
status.show.whenNotToUse: Not as a reply to chat about how you feel.

skills.list.title: List your skills
skills.list.whenToUse: To see which skills you have, which are open to you here, and why the rest are closed.
skills.list.whenNotToUse: Not when you already know the skill you need.

access.request.title: Ask for a skill
access.request.whenToUse: To leave the owner a request to open a skill you need; the owner decides.
access.request.whenNotToUse: Not for a skill already open to you, and not again for one you already asked about.
